1. रंह् रंह् (akin to लङ्घ्, q. cf.), i. 1, Par. and † i. 10, Par. To go, to move, with speed.
 --Caus. To impel to speed,

= Rigv. i. 85, 5.
 --Cf. perhaps τρέχω; Goth. thragjan; in this case the Sskr. word has dropped the initial.
† 2. रंह् रंह्, वंह् वंह्, i. 10, Par. To speak, to shine.

रन्तिदेव, m.
 1. A name of Viṣṇu.
 2. The name of a king,

रन्तु, f.
 1. A road.
 2. A river.

रन्धन, i. e. रध्, Caus., + अन,
 1. Destroying, Bhāg.

रन्ध्र, i. e. रध्, Caus., + र, n.
 1. A hole, a fissure, Pañc. ii. d. 42 (cf. also
 3.).
 2. A cavity, Śiś. 4, 61.
 3. A fault, a defect, a weak point, Pañc. 182, 2.
 --Comp.
